title: Police Blotter: 5 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Five people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges — theft, burglary of a vehicle, criminal trespass and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Five people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

San Juana Cardenas

San Juana Cardenas was arrested on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 4:43 a.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jennifer Itzel Sosa-Rangel

Jennifer Itzel Sosa-Rangel was arrested on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:21 a.m. on an alleged charge of accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,002. The record shows an out-of-county/state hold.

Kelsey Kuehne Dunn

Kelsey Kuehne Dunn was arrested on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 10:09 a.m. on an alleged charge of burglary of a vehicle, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Rude Alvarado

Rude Alvarado was arrested on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 2:05 p.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $750 to less than $2,500, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The record shows an out-of-county/state hold.

Pedro Ruiz

Pedro Ruiz was arrested on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 4:09 p.m. on an alleged charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $800. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
